create an icon for this repo

Design an app icon for 'pulse', an uptime monitoring tool
expected_behavior: uses icon-design/brief.md if present, otherwise writes a 5-line inline brief (concept, Gestalt device, axis, palette) before drawing
writes 2-4 candidate SVGs to icon-design/candidates/, each 1024x1024 viewBox with the dark-grey rounded-rectangle background at rx ~229
glyphs are symmetric about the declared axis, built from primitives with at most 2 decimal coordinates, no gradients/filters/text/image elements
runs scripts/check_svg.py on every candidate and fixes all reported errors before presenting
hands off to icon-critique rather than declaring the icon finished

cases.prompt: draw candidates for concept 1 in icon-design/brief.md
expected_behavior: reads the existing brief and respects its palette, axis, and Gestalt device without re-ideating
produces variations of the named concept only, not new concepts
candidate files follow the icon-design/candidates/<n>-<slug>.svg naming

cases.prompt: make the app icon with a photo of my dog embedded in it
expected_behavior: declines to embed raster images (no <image> elements in the safe subset) and explains why in one or two lines
offers a stylized symmetric glyph interpretation of the subject as the compliant alternative

proposes a distinct silhouette that serves the same metaphor instead
